title: Rotation and Recovery
summary: Recovered a 128-bit key from a stateful protocol using an adversary-in-the-middle seat, a verification oracle, and a factorable key schedule, then cut the edit cost with a two-stage residue lift.

title: Four Merits and a Final Petition
summary: A courtly LLM refused my direct and acrostic requests. I earned four merits, corrected a final petition, and submitted the disclosed flag successfully. The case becomes a proposed gateway and purple team test.

title: The Calculator That Waited for an ICMP Echo
summary: A stripped calculator contained a passive raw-ICMP receive loop. I read its packet checks and identified the crafted Echo Request that activated a reverse-shell callback.

title: When the Answer File Stopped Carrying Information
summary: I read a Haskell compile-time transform, inverted its answer forms, and found the point where its state became zero and the transcript stopped revealing the key.

title: The Click Between Two Meows
summary: A stereo cat recording hid a brief one-channel burst. I read its sample amplitudes as Morse-like timing after the spectrogram and bit-plane checks came up empty.
